title: Meow
description: MeowPlugin is an entertaining social plugin for Minecraft (Spigot 1.16+) designed for RP and cute interactions between players
body:
MeowPlugin is a lightweight, fun Minecraft Spigot/Paper plugin designed for cute and playful player interactions with a cat/anime theme.

## Commands

- **/meow** <player> — Meow at a nearby player
- **/punch** <player> — Punch a player with configurable knockback
- **/kiss** <player> — Kiss a nearby player
- **/hug** <player> — Hug a nearby player
- **/nyah** <player> — Say "nyah" to a player (flirty/cute message)
- **/dance** — Perform a short dance with customizable particles
- **/pat** <player> - Pat a player on the head
- **/boop** <player> - Boop a player's nose
- **/purr** - Purr cutely
- **/meowreload** — Reload plugin configuration (permission required)

## About

The plugin is perfect for roleplay servers, SMPs, or any community that enjoys wholesome/cute interactions. All actions are limited by distance and cooldowns to prevent spam.
